title: Storybound waypoint marker style
description: assets/<namespace>/storybound/waypoint_styles/<path>.json in a resource pack. A waypoint picks one with its style field (default storybound:default). Sprites are GUI sprites (assets/<ns>/textures/gui/sprites/<path>.png), white on transparent, tinted in game. Missing fields take the built-in defaults.

area_icon.description: The marker of a search area (radius > 0).

arrow.description: The arrow at the screen edge, pointing up; turned in game.

size.description: Icon size in GUI pixels, before the player's scale setting.

tracked_color.description: Tint of the tracked quest's markers; others take the waypoint's colour.

name.description: When the name shows above the icon. tracked: always for the tracked quest, near the crosshair for the rest.

distance.description: Show the distance under the icon.

max_distance.description: Blocks; farther markers are hidden unless their quest is tracked. 0 for no limit.

edge.description: Which off-screen waypoints get an arrow at the screen edge.
